name: The Giant Kins
description: Stone Giants. Led by the Stoneseer, they guide their kin by connecting with the earth and divinating the future. They are stoic and unbending in their ways, carving their homes in the mountains where they build rune-carved obelisks that protect their cities. Their divinations have been predicting a great evil involving the corruption of a mighty ancient dragon. They are currently trying to interpret their visions and find a way to stop them from coming past. Hill Giants.Led by the Tribal Matrons, these wise female elders carry the wisdom of their ancestors while communing with nature to find the paths and bring the land’s bounty. Living in nomadic tribes, they are great hunters and gatherers deeply tied to the valley’s nature. Due to the temples of Bás in the west, the climate in the valley has been changing; the warm currents that should reach the valley are now arriving at incorrect times. Many Tribal Matrons are worried and seeking the One Council for some action before nature is disrupted and their people fall hungry. Cloud Giants. Led by their Council of the Wise, they live in floating spires on the top of the tallest mountains, delving into magic and philosophy; they are reclusive and only leave their dwellings to the One Council meetings. The cloud giants are secretly researching magic to combat the Ungods and even venturing into the Penumbral Plane. But some of them were imprisoned during journeys or corrupted inside the dreadful plane. Not willing to risk more of their wise, they are looking for help from smaller folk experienced with the Penumbral Plane. Storm Giants. Led by the King of Storms, they stay in the mountains to the south and east that border with the human territories, keeping guards so no intrusions enter their valley and being the overseers that keep other giants from breaking the Pact. The storm giants are acutely aware of the doings of Abhorroth and are in a veiled confrontation against his gathering forces. The King is unwilling to start a war, but a few fights have occurred. Yet, unknown to him, many of his subjects are secretly aligning with the Dark Titan and are ready for betrayal. Frost Giants. Led by Queen of Ice, currently Yviah, they take home into icy fortresses in the north; keeping their militaristic traditions, they dedicate themselves to strenuous training in combat and are tasked with vanquishing any threat that may appear against the giant kin. Yviah, at the forefront of the fight against Abhorroth, was once an ally of the heroes during the Kemet Invasion. She is currently sending requests for assistance to the Allied Forces. While she can’t propose a direct alliance between the giants and them, as that would break the Pact, she uses her connection to ask for help in exchange for gold and magic weapons. Yet she knows that any help would require entering the Giant lands unnoticed, as the giants will not allow any trespassing, and she can’t formally invite them in, especially at this time of inner turmoil.
